text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I have an unending case of the<n>hiccups today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you just hiccup?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you just hiccup?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hiccups are kinda funny. I like<n>how you
bounce and make noise<n>even though you're not
doing<n>anything.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negligence is the greatest enemy.<n>They say you
can develop a serious<n>illness if you let hiccups
continue<n>unabated.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? R-really?! Oh no! Are you<n>okay, Big
Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? R-really?! Oh no! Are you<n>okay, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got it! They'll go away if you're<n>scared, right?!
Take this, Big Brother!<n>Bwah! Oooh! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got it! They'll go away if you're<n>scared, right?!
Take this, Big Sister!<n>Bwah! Oooh! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Current tactics deemed ineffective. I<n>suggest a
stronger element of<n>surprise.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... I see. Then, I'll do my best to<n>be more
surprising!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm... coming... Ready... here I am!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urara, la la la! ♪ Hi, Rice! Whatcha<n>doin'?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Urara?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I got it! You're playing hide-and-seek!<n>I wanna play!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-h-hold on a second. It's not<n>hide-and-seek...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-boo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Why are you still<n>hiccupping?! Grr! Stop it,
hiccups! Go<n>away!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing situation.<n>Conclusion—impact insufficient.
To<n>apply status "surprised" to your<n>trainer, you
require both more volume<n>and force.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've got it this time... As soon as Big<n>Brother comes
by, I'm going to leap<n>out of the shed!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've got it this time... As soon as Big<n>Sister comes
by, I'm going to leap out<n>of the shed!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clatter! Click!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh? The door won't open! Nooo,<n>why?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'll be able to<n>surprise anyone like
this. I'm<n>useless... as usual.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This way, Rice. I know how to<n>increase the success
rate of your<n>strategy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From my observations, I have<n>determined that
Rice's overwhelming<n>kindness has rendered her
unable to<n>surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have taken it upon myself<n>to make
modifications.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If she were to become a cyborg with<n>a steel heart,
then her likelihood of<n>success would improve
dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seem that news does not faze<n>you. I have
determined overly<n>exaggerated setting are the
cause.<n>Mission failure.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-boo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh... Did I... Did I actually surprise<n>you? Did your...
hiccups stop?
choice_data_list: I think my heart's gonna stop too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Our tactic of striking once the target let<n>their guard
down was successful.<n>Mission accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your help, Bourbon! I<n>couldn't have
done it without you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it was just me, Big Brother would<n>probably have
kept hiccupping<n>forever and ever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it was just me, Big Sister would<n>probably have
kept hiccupping<n>forever and ever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle. I'm so glad! Thank you somuch, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just hiccups, I'm<n>grateful that these
two would work so<n>hard to help me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Did we scare you too much?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should we do?! How do you<n>cancel out
surprise?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe one must offer reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Creek informed me that saying<n>"there, there" or a
pat on the head can<n>be effective.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
G-got it. Just like Creek would do...<n>There, there...
there, there!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And now, Rice Shower has thrown<n>herself into
reassuring me.
